entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the Petitioner, learned P.P. for the State and learned counsel for the Informant.

2. The Petitioner has approached this Court for grant of regular bail in connection with Mandar P.S.
Case No. 43 of 2025, registered for the offence under Sections 406, 420 and 34 of the Indian Penal Code, pending in the Court of learned Judicial Magistrate,-XII, Ranchi 3.

Learned counsel for the Petitioner submits that the Petitioner has been falsely implicated in this case and has not committed any offence whatsoever as alleged in the F.I.R. He further submits that petitioner was Non-Executive Director in the Company, who was appointed on 16.09.2019 and resigned on 13.01.2021 with only 1% share in the Company and the entire alleged amount has been paid to the said Company and not in the Bank Account of this petitioner and he has been languishing in custody since 24.04.2025; hence, the petitioner may be enlarged on bail.
4. Learned P.P. opposed the prayer for bail of the Petitioner.

5. Having regard to the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case, I am inclined to enlarge the Manwill Srivastava vs The State Of Jharkhand --Opposite Party on 5 June, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/110061583/

sentences.text:
1 Petitioner on provisional bail till the next date of hearing on furnishing bail bond of Rs. 20,000/-
(Twenty Thousand Only) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned Judicial Magistrate,-XII, Ranchi, in connection with Mandar P.S. Case No. 43 of 2025.
List this case on 30.06.2025.
In the meantime, learned counsel for the State shall file counter affidavit.
